references.text: Complementary account of the same judgment against Benjamin confirming that the entire tribe of brave warriors was wiped out.
Contrast reference showing Benjamin's temporary victory before the final judgment, illustrating God's sovereign control over the outcome of war.
Historical precursor showing Israel's great loss on the first day, setting in perspective the final judgment against Benjamin on the third day.
Critical context showing Benjamin's total strength before the war, emphasizing how complete the destruction was in the source verse.
